title: introduce-cross-seed-stability-gate-with-attenuated-quarantine
author: Evan Chen
description:
Motivation: We observed a recurring class of transient failures in prompt-set regression CI caused by seed-sensitive outputs and high-variance cohorts. This PR implements a cross-seed stability gate that aggregates per-prompt signals across multiple RNG seeds, applies an attenuation function to reduce the impact of single-seed outliers, and quarantines prompts with reproducible regressions for progressive manual review.

What this PR does: - Adds a new CI hook (cross_seed_stability_gate) that computes a noise-aware p-value and stability score per prompt by running N independent seeds and combining results with an attenuation curve. - Implements a quarantine flow: prompts that fail the attenuated threshold are moved to a quarantine artifact (CSV + JSONL) and an automatic backfill job is suggested to collect historical performance for context. - Introduces a new metric aggregator (stability_index) that reports cohort-level percentiles, inter-seed variance, and an explainable failure reason tag (e.g., length-sensitive, sampling-noise, model-drift). - Adds a lightweight retrospective mode: when run in "retrospect" mode the hook replays the last successful baseline snapshot and produces a diffed report for SRE/ML owners. - Improves CI ergonomics: junit-style annotations for quarantined prompts, a small console summary for fast failures, and GitHub check annotations linking directly to quarantine artifacts.

Checklist: - [x] Core gate implementation and tests - [x] Quarantine artifact writer and upload helper - [x] Backfill suggestion script and docs - [x] Unit tests covering seed aggregation and attenuation - [x] Integration smoke test in CI workflow - [x] Documentation updates for maintainers

High-level commits: - 7a1d3e2: implement cross-seed stability gate core logic and CLI entrypoint - c3f9b4a: add quarantine writer, upload helper, and small S3 shim for CI artifacts - f8b2c44: tests: add unit and integration tests for attenuated scoring across seeds - d1e4a01: docs: add maintainers.md and CI usage examples - ea3b9f0: fix: address race condition in artifact upload (retry + backoff)

Changed files (high level): - eval_harness/ci/hooks/cross_seed_stability_gate.py - eval_harness/ci/hooks/utils/attenuation.py - eval_harness/ci/backfill/suggest_backfill.py - eval_harness/tests/test_cross_seed_gate.py - docs/ci-stability-gates.md - workflows/ci-eval.yml (adds a gated job step)

Why it's safe: The gate is additive to existing CI flows and defaults to non-blocking quarantine mode for the first rollout (maintainer opt-in to blocking). Thresholds are configurable via environment variables and Linear tasks (ENG-2048) track tuning. The quarantine artifacts are read-only and accompanied by a suggested backfill command to gather context before any corrective action.

Migration/ops notes: - To flip the gate to blocking, set CI_ENV_STABILITY_BLOCK=true in protected branches or release pipelines after a 2-week observational period. - Artifact storage requires the CI S3 bucket to accept a new prefix (ci/quarantine/). The PR includes a small S3 shim with retries; ops should provide creds to CI. - Users are advised to run `scripts/suggest_backfill.py --cohort <name>` if many prompts land in quarantine to expedite triage.

Related work: builds on ideas from ENG-1210 (cohort anchoring) and recent ephemeral-flakiness mitigations, but focuses specifically on cross-seed aggregation and attenuated scoring to reduce single-seed false positives.
